title.en: Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Ryakudatsusareta no de, Koushaku-ke na Kouhai to Gisou Kon'yaku shitara Naze ka Dekiaisareteimasu.
Janai Kata no Hakushaku Reijou - Hitochigai de Kyuukonsareta no de Hadan ni shite Sashiagemasu
Dokushin Shugi no Reijou wa, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai kara Nogaretai
Amai Okashi no Nochi wa Amai Dekiai wo - Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa Henkyou Haku Shisoku ni Dekiaisareru
Akuyaku Reijou wa Boukensha ni Naru Tame Konyaku Haki wo Nozomimasu
Watashi wo Dekiaishi Sugiru Danna-sama wa Konya mo Furete Kuremasen
Kenka Bakari Datta Konyakusha ga Ikinari Dekiai shitekimasu
Kanpeki Sugiru ga Kosando mo Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa Ringoku no Outaishi to Musubareru?!
Kouri no Koushaku-sama to Karisome no Hanayome - Kozukuri Shitara Rikon no Hazu ga, Naze ka Chouaisaretemasu
Kokou no Bocchi Reijou wa Hatsukoi Ouji ni Furaretai
Ouhi ni Naru Yotei Deshita ga, Nise Seijo no Omei wo Kiserareta no de Toubou Shitara, Koutaishi ni Dekiai Saremashita. Sochira mo Douzo Oshiawase ni
Hanayome Shuugyou wo Yametakute, Reitetsu Koushaku no 13-banme no Konyakusha ni narimasu
Kokoro wo Tozashita Koushaku Kakka to Konyaku Shita Hazu na no ni, Naze ka Taisetsu ni Sasete Shimattemasu!
